articles.title: Phillies won’t play on NBC Sports Philadelphia the next few nights amid playoff push
articles.description: The final two games of the Phillies-Mets series will be back on NBC Sports Philadelphia Saturday or Sunday. With Tom McCarthy calling Sunday’s NFL matchup between the Cleveland Browns and Tampa Bay ...

articles.title: With Jesús Luzardo out, Phillies hitters need to start earning their millions
articles.description: The bullpen, baserunning, and defense are a mess and Jesus Luzardo is out. But the starting pitching is still good. Bryce Harper, Kyle Schwarber, Trea Turner, J.T. Realmuto need to step up now.

articles.title: Zack Wheeler delivers seven scoreless innings in Phillies’ shutout of the Nationals: ‘They’re all must-win’
articles.description: Wheeler allowed just four hits and struck out five. The Phillies' offense worked a season-high 13 walks, but left 14 on base.

articles.title: Phillies pitcher Jesús Luzardo is playing it ‘smart’ by not playing through his nagging shoulder stiffness
articles.description: The Phillies have no plans to place Luzardo on the 15-day injured list as they're hoping that rest will help clear up the stiffness, enabling him to start next week.

articles.title: Phillies see chance at catching Atlanta’s NL East lead dwindle following 10-run loss to Braves
articles.description: The Braves had scored eight runs in the fourth inning, with seven of those runs coming while they sat with two outs.

articles.title: Alec Bohm leads a late offensive surge to power Phillies past the Braves: ‘Kept piling on the hits’
articles.description: Alec Bohm changed the momentum after he put the Phillies back in front in the eighth inning and salvaged the final game of the series with a 9-4 win in Atlanta.

articles.title: Baserunning miscue looms large for Phillies in series-opening loss to Braves
articles.description: Bryce Harper was caught between second and third in the top of the ninth, erasing the Phillies' best chance at an insurance run. The Braves ultimately walked them off in 11 innings.

articles.title: Phillies scratch Jesús Luzardo from Saturday’s start vs. Atlanta Braves
articles.description: The Phillies instead will go with a bullpen game for Saturday's matchup with the NL East-leading Atlanta Braves.

articles.title: Phillies reliever Jonathan Bowlan has a right groin strain, but he won’t go on the injured list
articles.description: Bowlan, the Phillies' primary setup man, says this injury isn't as "extreme" as the one he suffered in April, and interim manager Don Mattingly explained why they're leaving him on the active roster.

articles.title: Phillies Extra: Former GM Matt Klentak reflects on his Phillies tenure, working with the Brewers, and more
articles.description: With the Brewers coming to town, the former Phillies GM joined The Inquirer's baseball show to discuss his current and former teams.

articles.title: Aaron Nola turns back the clock with dominant outing in Phillies’ shutout win over Mets
articles.description: Nola threw 81 pitches over seven innings — a model of efficiency and effectiveness — in a 3-0 victory over the Mets. In his last 10 starts, he has a 2.10 ERA in 60 innings.

articles.title: Don Mattingly, Brandon Marsh lament Phillies’ baserunning miscues after loss to Astros: ‘It can cost you a game’
articles.description: Painter gave up four runs in the second inning and five in total across five innings. The loss prevented the Phillies from gaining ground in both the division and wild-card races.
